title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Stadium on 1991-10-27
taper: DAT source provided by B.Koucky (rec'd from B.Fried 1996).
source: SBD > DAT(48KHz) > DAT playback on Sony PCM-R500 > XLR analog outputs > Mogami Gold cables > Neutrik inputs, Presonus Firebox (pre-amplification and analog-to-digital) > firewire > PC/WinXP Pro > recorded to 24 bit/96 KHz WAV withWavelab 5 > mastered with Waves L3 Multimaximizer (threshold of -2.9 dB, ceiling -0.1 dB)> rendered to 16 bit /44.1 KHz WAV using UV22-HR dithering (normal/no autoblack) > tracked with CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of an emotionally charged show just two days after Bill Graham's death, highlighted by a mind‑blowing performance of “Mona”.
ai_review.review: The tape captures the band playing with palpable feeling – reviewers repeatedly note how the boys gave their all and that the night felt special because it was the first concert after Bill Graham’s tragic helicopter crash. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity, easily outshining any audience tapes, and “Mona” is singled out as a standout moment.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one review are 4‑5 stars and focus on the emotional intensity of the performance and the clear soundboard source; no significant complaints were raised.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers comment that the soundboard capture is vivid and outshines audience recordings; no mentions of muddiness, drop‑outs or other issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A heartfelt, emotionally charged set that served as a tribute to Bill Graham, with the band playing at peak intensity throughout.
